Name: Abigail Spirit's Eve - Malenia - Seasonal Outfits
Author: rachelkel04
Description:
THIS IS NOT A MOD, THIS IS JUST THE IMAGE FILES. You will need the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450]Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic[/url] mod and then replace the images!

I saw Abigail's knight costume and thought it was a little boring (don't get me wrong, it's a great costume, but I wanted something more), so I had the brilliant idea: what if she dressed up as Malenia? I made an initial sketch and sent it to a [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/itras100?pk_vid=9efcf957c2f775a91756348828518434]friend [/url]who made it a reality (thank you so much!), he worked on the portraits and I worked on the sprites.

[code]﻿[/code] 

[size=5]Installation:
[/size]
[list]
[*]Download mod manually and unzip
[*]Open the "abigail" folder
[*]You will find two folders: "character" and "portrait"
[*]Copy the images and paste them into the "abigail" folder of Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic, overwrite all changes (put the portrait images  in the "abigail" folder located in the "portraits" folder from the mod, and the character images in the "abigail" folder located in the "characters" folder from the mod)
[*]Run game as normal
[/list]

I hope you like it! Also, feel free to comment if you have any feedback or something doesn't work. Thank you!
